decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate requires agricultural domain knowledge not closely related to the firm's existing industrial packaging expertise, limiting its ability to assimilate early market feedback and improve the product.
The foldable large container builds on the firm's existing container and crate knowledge, so early results can be interpreted and the product improved.
As a standard stackable plastic crate, this product is at the core of the firm's existing plastic product knowledge, yielding high absorptive capacity.
The medium-duty rackable pallet leverages the firm's established pallet design and manufacturing knowledge, enabling effective learning from market results.
Although spill-retention pallets add chemical containment requirements, the firm's existing pallet knowledge provides a sufficient base to interpret results and improve the product.
The plastic pallet with load retainers extends the firm's existing pallet product line, so related knowledge supports learning and product refinement.
